description: Crank-train dynamics oracle: reflected mechanism inertia J_m(theta) from finite-difference velocities of the numerical loop-closure solution, inertia torque -(J_m*alpha + 0.5*dJ_m/dtheta*omega^2) (Lagrange), gravity torque -dU/dtheta. SI units; theta in crank degrees, 0 = firing TDC; torques positive in the rotation direction.
multiDescription: Multi-cylinder crank train on one rigid crank: cylinder i at theta - firingOffsetDeg[i] (raw 720-deg offsets). Totals J, dJ/dtheta, gravity torque; per-cylinder dx/dtheta and gas torque (p_i - pCrankcase)*A*dx/dtheta per state; total inertia torque -(J*alpha + 0.5*dJ*omega^2); free acceleration (sum gas + gravity - 0.5*dJ*omega^2 + externalTorque)/(rotatingInertia + loadInertia + J).
